# unifi_features (Data Source)

The `unifi_features` data source lists all controller features and their availability on a site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all controller features and their availability on the site.
data "unifi_features" "all" {}

output "available_features" {
  value = [for f in data.unifi_features.all.features : f.name if f.feature_exists]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `features` (Attributes List) The list of controller features. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))

<a id="nestedatt--features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `features`

Optional:

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

- `name` (String) The name of the feature.
